note: PSoXide Demo Disc v0.45, public pressing, all XA: no CD-DA track. Every program is its library build of 2026-10-17 or 2026-10-18 (Celeste 0.2.8 from the pressed main release disc, Quake main c14ec10 with save and load, Arcade e016f09 built for this pressing); Cortex (Graybox Reach) keeps the XA build of v0.44, the library holds only the CD-DA twin. Launcher menu music is XA (Mulula VGM Loops, CC BY 4.0). Public pressing only: Half-Life, Hollow Knight, WipEout, Counter-Strike, Ocarina of Time and the hardware tests are never on it, and a public file is checked for that (disc-tools public-only). Hashes gate every input; disc-tools lineup refuses a file that changed.

programs.name: PSOXIDE ARCADE
programs.build: make disc on psoxide-arcade main e016f09 (panic=immediate-abort), SDK b5365b18, editor c096eee0, emulator 9e007839; Goncharov as MUSIC1.XA inside the image, one data track, no CD-DA. Shot cooks and card cooks run as the repo recipe (Pillow scripts).

programs.name: CELESTE COLLECTION
programs.build: release/celeste-collection.bin on celeste-collection-psx main (the pressed 0.2.8 disc: brightness stepper, text palette fix, 32-bit sound and fixed-point maths, SDK b5365b18). The library still holds 0.2.7 (579f14f8).

programs.name: NITROXIDE
programs.build: the library NitroXide install of 2026-10-17 (INSTALLED.json): make compile and make pack on main 9b70726 with the committed XA music; the goal-post glow edge fix over feb0cd9.

programs.name: VOXIDE
programs.build: the library VoXide install of 2026-10-17 (INSTALLED.json): the frame retune on SDK b5365b18 / editor c096eee0, built with make gate-disc; three-vblank frames on the Manny tape 131 -> 38.

programs.name: QUAKE SHAREWARE
programs.build: the library Quake install of 2026-10-18 (quake-psx.provenance.json): main c14ec10 (save and load, 6 KB more save buffer), PSoXide c096eee0, SDK b5365b18; shareware 1.06 data, XA music, one data track, no CD-DA.

programs.name: CORTEX IGNITION
programs.build: frontend build-project-disc --project editor/projects/graybox-reach on feat/engine-xa-music-2026-10-15 (SDK 36ead4b, emulator 6edde550): the two Music nodes as MUSIC1.XA after UI.PAK, one data track, no CD-DA. The default (0.4b) project does not link on editor main, so Graybox Reach stands in the Cortex slot.

programs.name: PSXCEL
programs.build: the library PSXcel install of 2026-10-17 (PSXcel.provenance.json): make disc with panic=immediate-abort, SDK b5365b18, editor c096eee0, emulator b3848054; the disc carries the image's boot EXE as a bare program.
